component.name: Avestruz
component.summary: A Nostr client in the COSMIC panel

description.p: Read and write Nostr from your COSMIC panel: a button in the panel, and a popup that is the whole client.

ul.li: The feed of the people you follow, read from the relays each of them writes to
Threads, profiles, search, notifications and private bookmarks
Notes, replies and quotes, with drafts kept and files attached through Blossom media servers
Reactions, reposts, and zaps by Lightning invoice
Pictures, link previews and videos shown and played in the feed
Sign in with a key kept in the system keyring, or with a remote signer
Your relay lists, with what each relay says of itself
A key for everything: step through notes, open, reply, repost, zap, bookmark
